repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The JoI condition has inverted arithmetic direction. IR requires ($v1 - $v2) >= 20 to detect volume drop (initial minus final), but JoI uses (v2 - v1 >= 20) which detects volume increase. With input v1=0, v2=20, IR evaluates (-20 >= 20) = false (no action), while JoI evaluates (20 >= 20) = true (action triggered). F2 confirms IR emitted no action at 300000ms while JoI emitted speaker.speak.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed condition from (v2 - v1 >= 20) to (v1 - v2 >= 20) to match IR specification. This preserves the semantics of detecting volume drop (initial volume minus final volume >= 20) while maintaining all other behavior unchanged.
